stops.note: from 'trekken', to pull or draw, used for any pull-lever such as a drawer-pull or bell-pull
anglicized spelling adopted for the lever of a gunlock
spelling shifted closer to the Dutch original; sense broadened figuratively
stops.meaning: a device that sets off a mechanism, or anything that sets off a reaction

current_meaning: a device that fires a mechanism, or anything that sets off a chain of events
